newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee gains on rising money rates.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee gains on rising money rates.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed substantially higher against the dollar due to rising money rates, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.95 after opening at its previous closing level of 57.04.
"Rising call money rates saw banks willing to carry minus positions," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Call money closed at 18.5 percent after opening at 16 percent, as two big state banks continued to borrow, dealers said.
